description: The AWS::SecurityHub::OrganizationConfiguration resource represents the configuration of your organization in Security Hub. Only the Security Hub administrator account can create Organization Configuration resource in each region and can opt-in to Central Configuration only in the aggregation region of FindingAggregator.. Source:- https://github.com/aws-cloudformation/aws-cloudformation-resource-providers-securityhub

AutoEnable.description: Whether to automatically enable Security Hub in new member accounts when they join the organization.

AutoEnableStandards.description: Whether to automatically enable Security Hub default standards in new member accounts when they join the organization.

ConfigurationType.description: Indicates whether the organization uses local or central configuration.

title: AWSSecurityHubOrganizationConfigurationProperties
